generations.name: rocket-artillery-ally
generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 2D tactical strategy game unit sprite, production art for rtsvibe. Create ONE allied rocket artillery truck, orthographic straight overhead view, nose and front cab pointing straight UP / north. Exactly six chunky wheels, three visibly arranged along EACH side. Olive green / khaki painted armored truck, compact front cab, longer rear chassis carrying TWO bulky rectangular multiple-launch rocket pods side by side with a clear gap. The pods have repeated sealed launch tube housings, thick panel grids, short hints of missile noses at their north ends, not four exposed long antiaircraft missiles. Clear wide silhouette different from an antiair vehicle, and wheel design distinct from a tank's tracks. Match illustrated existing military game sprites: dark ink contours, painted olive panels, restrained warm highlights, subtle wear, simplified large shapes, no pixel art, no glossy 3D, no isometric perspective. A consistent top-left light applied only to the object. Perfectly centered on a square canvas, whole vehicle visible with generous transparent padding, no cutoff. Design for legibility when downscaled to 128x128 and viewed at 56x56, avoid microscopic details. BACKGROUND MUST BE REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. No terrain, no checkerboard baked into image, no black/white background, no cast shadow outside the vehicle, no text, lettering, symbols, watermark, smoke, fire or missile trails. Exactly one vehicle, not a sprite sheet.

generations.name: rocket-artillery-enemy
generations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied olive rocket artillery sprite to make its RED ENEMY TEAM variant. Preserve exactly the six-wheel truck, two rectangular launch pods and their missile tube details, orthographic top-down perspective, nose pointing up, pose, silhouette, outlines, lighting, crop, proportions and all mechanical details. Change only the olive/khaki painted body panels and pod paint to clearly readable muted military RED / deep brick red, with slightly lighter red highlights, consistent with the existing red enemy sprites in a 2D tactical strategy game. Keep rubber wheels dark charcoal, glass dark and metal details neutral. No added guns, missiles, objects, insignias or text. Preserve the real transparent alpha background, no background or ground shadow. Keep the entire vehicle inside the square canvas.

generations.name: recon-drone-ally-original
generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 2D tactical strategy game unit sprite, production art for rtsvibe. Create ONE allied reconnaissance drone: a military uncrewed fixed-wing aircraft with LONG thin horizontal wings, narrow fuselage, pointed nose pointing exactly UP / north, small V-shaped tail surfaces at the bottom, compact rear pusher propeller. No weapons, missile racks or bombs. A small sensor housing under the nose is suggested through simple fuselage contour and dark sensor detailing, without tilting the camera. Strict orthographic straight overhead view, symmetrical horizontal wings, full aircraft visible, no isometric view. Olive green / khaki painted metal, dark ink contours, restrained warm highlights, subtle panel seams and painted shading. Match illustrated military game sprites, not photorealistic, not glossy 3D, not pixel art. Clearly a long-wing reconnaissance airplane, not a helicopter or quadcopter. Shape and simple high-contrast details must remain legible at 128x128 and 56x56. Centered on a square canvas with generous transparent padding on every side. Consistent top-left light applied only to the aircraft. BACKGROUND MUST BE REAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. No terrain, clouds, altitude labels, smoke, ground shadow, sky, checkerboard baked into image, black/white background, lettering or watermark. Exactly one aircraft, not a sprite sheet.
